steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere in Alaska on a schedule that fits your work calendar. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum PMI requires in one intensive program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and professional experience. Pay the PMI exam fee when you apply. Our team guides you through every document requirement to ensure a smooth submission.

steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle by completing PMI-approved education, volunteer work, or on-the-job practice. Renew your credential before it expires to keep your competitive edge in Anchorage's project-driven industries.
